snippet.title: Layers of Fear | Special Event | “The Sick Rose” | Announcement
snippet.description:
Exactly ten years was the moment that defined us as a horror game studio, to celebrate this moment we’re bringing you this special showcase! 

Tune in and celebrate the 10th anniversary of Layers of Fear!
